set.title: Set your password
set.heading: Set your password
set.intro: Your account is made and your order is with it. Choose a password and it is yours to sign in with.
set.successBody: You can sign in with your new password whenever you like.
set.linkFailure: This link is no longer valid. If you have already set a password, sign in with it. If not, ask for a new link from the sign in page.
set.signInPrompt: Go to the sign in page
set.rateLimited: That is a few too many tries. Wait a moment and try once more.
set.unknownFailure: Something went wrong at our end. Your password has not been changed. Try again in a moment.

reset.title: Choose a new password
reset.heading: Choose a new password
reset.intro: Pick a new password for your account. The old one stops working as soon as you do.
reset.successBody: You can sign in with it now.
reset.linkFailure: This link is no longer valid. Reset links last an hour and work once. Ask for a new one from the sign in page.
reset.signInPrompt: Go to the sign in page
reset.rateLimited: That is a few too many tries. Wait a moment and try once more.
reset.unknownFailure: Something went wrong at our end. Your password has not been changed. Try again in a moment.
